subject: SSO + SCIM + IP allowlist orchestration for Ozmetrix onboarding
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma.li@ozmetrix.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Rahul Singh <rahul.singh@ozmetrix.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Ozmetrix: kickoff — SSO/SCIM/IP allowlist sequencing

Hi Naomi / Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to move from trial to pilot next week and want to lock the identity/network steps so our security team can schedule firewall windows. High level asks:
- SAML metadata exchange and IdP attributes (email, name, roles)
- SCIM provisioning schema expectations (we provision users and groups)
- IP allowlist ranges for production and staging (we need CIDR blocks)
- Service account names and scopes (for API-based user sync)

Can you confirm who from Redwood will own each item and estimated lead times? Also attaching our internal firewall change request for the earliest window (fw-change-request.pdf).

If possible, we'd like to complete the SAML exchange by Wednesday and SCIM by Friday so our infra team can schedule a maintenance window next week.

Thanks,
Emma Li
Director of IT, Ozmetrix
emma.li@ozmetrix.com
+1 415-555-0198

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@ozmetrix.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rahul Singh <rahul.singh@ozmetrix.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Dec 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Ozmetrix: kickoff — SSO/SCIM/IP allowlist sequencing

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear list. Below is the proposed ownership and timeline from our side: 

- SAML metadata & IdP attributes: Ben Carter (Security Solutions Engineer) — will exchange metadata and confirm required attributes by Tuesday EOD.
- SCIM schema & attribute mapping: Monica Patel (CS Engineer) — provide our SCIM expectations and example payloads by Thursday morning.
- IP allowlist ranges: Naomi Feldman (Customer Success Manager) — provide canonical CIDR list for staging/prod and staging runbook by Wednesday morning.
- Service accounts & scopes: Ben — share recommended service account names and token scopes plus the service-account CSV by Thursday.

I will coordinate sign-off steps and hand-off to your infra team for the firewall window; I see you attached the FW change request — thanks, that helps.

Proposed meetings: 30m technical sync (Ben + Rahul + Ozmetrix infra) tomorrow 11:00 PT, and a 15m sign-off on Friday 14:00 PT. Are those slots OK?

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Emma Li <emma.li@ozmetrix.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Dec 2027 14:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Ozmetrix: kickoff — SSO/SCIM/IP allowlist sequencing

Emma / team — adding the technical details you'll need. Attaching: ozmetrix-saml-metadata.xml, scim-schema-v2.pdf, and a preliminary redwood-service-accounts.csv.

SAML notes:
- We support SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows. We'll need your IdP metadata (or Okta/ADFS config) and the attribute map: email (NameID/email), given_name, family_name, and optional role claim (custom attribute: redwood_roles).
- ACS URL: https://api.redwood.ai/sso/callback/ozmetrix
- EntityID: urn:redwood:ozmetrix:prod

SCIM notes:
- We implement SCIM v2; recommended attributes in scim-schema-v2.pdf. Group sync supported via /Groups endpoint. Scoping: we can provision users + group membership.
- Rate limits: provisioning calls are limited to 50 reqs/min per service account; recommend batching sync during initial import.

Service accounts:
- Suggested names in redwood-service-accounts.csv. Each account uses an API key scoped to SCIM:users.write and SCIM:groups.write. Keys rotate every 90 days by default, can be extended with an SSO-based KeyVault integration (enterprise add-on).

IP allowlist: Naomi, can you confirm the staging and prod CIDR ranges you need; below are the /24 ranges we typically provide for pilot:
- staging: 34.210.12.0/24
- prod: 52.198.44.0/24
(we can expand or provide static FQDNs if your infra prefers)

I'll be on tomorrow's 11:00 PT sync to walk through the metadata.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Security Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Rahul Singh <rahul.singh@ozmetrix.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Dec 2027 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Ozmetrix: kickoff — SSO/SCIM/IP allowlist sequencing

Thanks Ben — that helps. A couple of clarifications from our network/security team: 
1) Can you provide dedicated /28 blocks for the pilot rather than /24? We need to avoid broad rules in our firewall. If not possible, we'll use the /24 but place additional rules on our side.
2) For service accounts: we prefer an HMAC key and explicit least-privilege scopes. Please confirm the exact header/auth pattern and TTL for tokens.
3) SCIM: we'll be syncing ~1,200 users initially with groups. Do you support incremental sync (list/changes) or only full replaces?

Attached our firewall change request (fw-change-request.pdf) with a suggested window Friday 2027-12-10 0200-0300 PT. Can you review and confirm whether that window works for Redwood?

Rahul Singh
Senior Infrastructure Engineer | Ozmetrix
rahul.singh@ozmetrix.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@ozmetrix.com>, Rahul Singh <rahul.singh@ozmetrix.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Dec 2027 11:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Ozmetrix: kickoff — SSO/SCIM/IP allowlist sequencing

Hi Emma / Rahul — quick update and final asks before we lock the pilot window.

Status:
- Ben has uploaded SAML metadata and the SCIM schema; confirm receipt.
- Monica will send our sample SCIM mapping JSON by Thursday morning.
- Network: we can provide tighter CIDR blocks but need to request a /28 allocation from the ops team; earliest we can confirm exact /28s is Thursday EOD. Staging /28s are likely, production may require additional steps.

Action items for Ozmetrix (please reply inline):
1) Confirm whether you accept SP-initiated SSO only or require IdP-initiated as well.
2) Confirm the Friday 2027-12-10 02:00–03:00 PT firewall window (we'll target staging cutover in that window).
3) Approve the service-account names in redwood-service-accounts.csv or propose alternate names.

Next steps / timeline:
- Thu EOD: Redwood confirms final /28 CIDRs.
- Fri morning: Monica sends SCIM mapping JSON and a quick test plan for provisioning.
- Fri 02:00–03:00 PT: Staging SSO + SCIM cutover and verification.

After you confirm the three items above I'll create a short sign-off doc (DocuSign) for the pilot cutover and share links to the logs/trace playbook.

Thanks — Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
